direction: Use a $p$-norm continuation method that naturally equalizes many pairs, rather than optimizing only the current maximum: minimize $F_p(X)=\left(\sum_{i<j}\max(\langle x_i,x_j\rangle-0.15,0)^p\right)^{1/p}$ or an equivalent shifted log-sum-exp energy, with analytic tangent gradient, Riemannian Adam or projected heavy-ball, and a schedule $p=8,16,32,64,128,256$ (about 250--400 steps per stage, learning rate decaying from $3\times10^{-3}$ to $3\times10^{-4}$), starting each run from `best.npy`, from `record.npy`, and from several strongly perturbed or random configurations with $\sigma\in\{0.15,0.3,0.6\}$. Localized bottleneck surgery deleting k points from the worst-pair neighbourhood and greedily reinserting them into frozen largest holes with cluster-frozen softmax refinement and full unfreezing, keeping diverse topologies via top-100 Jaccard.
direction: Perform targeted contact-topology surgery around the bottleneck instead of perturbing all 93 points: identify the unique worst pair and the union of each endpoint's 10--15 largest-cosine neighbours (typically 15--25 points), then in separate trials delete $k\in\{3,5,8,12\}$ points chosen from this cluster (sometimes including one bottleneck endpoint, sometimes not), greedily reinsert them one at a time at approximate largest holes found from 50,000 random sphere candidates followed by 200 steps of local minimization of the candidate's maximum cosine against the frozen plus already reinserted points, perturb the reinserted cluster by $10^{-3}$--$10^{-2}$, optimize the cluster with the remainder frozen, and finally unfreeze everything for the Direction-1 polish or a short annealed softmax polish. Run many such surgeries within the time budget and accept a child into the incumbent pool only if its polished maximum improves the incumbent or its top-100 contact-pair set has Jaccard similarity below about 0.85 with the incumbent, because a slightly worse but genuinely different contact topology is valuable while another copy of the same plateau is not.

direction: Build a small population-and-crossover search using contact-graph diversity as the selection criterion: generate perhaps 8--16 locally polished candidates through independent perturbations, hole reinsertions, and $p$-continuation runs, store for each its sorted slack spectrum and its pair set within $10^{-3}$ of the maximum, align pairs of parents by alternating Hungarian matching on $1-\langle x_i,y_j\rangle$ (`scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment`) with orthogonal Procrustes alignment, produce children by spherical interpolation of matched points at fractions $0.25,0.5,0.75$ plus a $10^{-3}$ tangent jitter, then repair each child with a short softmax optimization and LP polish. Maintain an archive that keeps the best candidate for each substantially different contact fingerprint rather than only the global best, repeatedly cross the incumbent with the most diverse archive members, and return the best polished child; this directly searches for recombined rigid substructures and new basins that neither pure local polishing nor single-parent random kicks can reach.

High-precision all-pairs tangent-space trust-region SQP that ties the near-contact cloud with exact max-cosine backtracking.
direction: Implement a high-precision, all-pairs active-set SQP finisher rather than another capped micro-LP: starting from `best.npy`, parametrize each displacement in a 12-dimensional tangent basis at $x_i$ (1116 variables plus $t$), include all 4278 linearized constraints $\langle x_i,x_j\rangle+x_i^\top d_j+x_j^\top d_i+\tfrac12 d_i^\top d_j\le t$ (dropping only pairs with slack $>10^{-3}$ if HiGHS is too slow, which should still retain the relevant cloud), and solve the trust-region LP with initial radius $3\times10^{-3}$, exact max-cosine backtracking, and radius expansion when predicted and actual reductions agree. Recompute the Gram matrix, active set, and second-order correction after every accepted step for up to about 120 seconds, explicitly tracking the numbers of pairs at slacks $10^{-10},10^{-8},10^{-6}$ and the least-squares KKT residual for the top 100 pairs; success is not merely a lower maximum but conversion of at least dozens, preferably hundreds, of the $10^{-6}$ cloud into ties at $10^{-10}$--$10^{-12}$, with the best iterate always retained as fallback.

direction: Rattler-first delete-and-reinsert surgery: load `best.npy`, compute per-point row maxima and the contact graph at thresholds $10^{-9},10^{-7},10^{-5}$, sort the 19 rattlers by increasing row-max, and for $k\in\{1,2,3,5,8,13,19\}$ delete the $k$ loosest points (trying also variants that delete the 12-contact hub instead of one rattler), then greedily reinsert points one at a time at the largest spherical void of the current set, found by sampling 60,000 random unit vectors, scoring by max cosine to existing points, and refining the best 20 candidates with softmax descent ($\tau=0.008\to0.001$) on their maximum dot product; after each insertion run shifted $p$-norm Adam ($p=32,64,128$, shift $0.20$) for a few hundred steps, finish each $k$-trial with top-$K$ ($K=150$) hard-max descent and a short trust-region LP polish, keep a strict time budget per trial, and return the best configuration found or the original if none improves.

idea: Three C31-orbit symmetric search over 39 parameters with annealed log-sum-exp and analytic gradients, then symmetry-breaking plus Adam/hard-max repolish.
direction: Symmetry-constrained search using three $C_{31}$ orbits ($3\times31=93$): parametrize the cyclic action on $\mathbb{R}^{13}$ by six 2D rotation planes with multipliers $a=(1,5,7,11,13,17)\bmod 31$ plus one fixed coordinate, so each orbit is determined by six radii (normalized), six phases, and one axial coordinate ($\approx13$ parameters per orbit, 39 total); generate an orbit by rotating a seed vector through $k=0,\dots,30$, optimize the smooth log-sum-exp max-cosine over these 39 parameters with many (50+) random restarts using `scipy.optimize.minimize` L-BFGS-B with analytic or finite-difference gradients and $\tau$ annealed $0.02\to0.002$, which enforces by construction equal contacts and equal row maxima within each orbit; take the best symmetric result, expand it to a full $(93,13)$ array, break symmetry with tangent perturbations of sizes $10^{-4},10^{-3},10^{-2}$, and repolish each with $p$-norm Adam plus LP, returning the best overall—this explores a genuinely different, rattler-free basin that perturbations of the record cannot reach.

idea: Reweighted per-point row-max equioscillation with annealed p and temperature plus multiplicative weights, Riemannian Adam, then top-K and LP trust-region polish.
direction: Row-max equioscillation by iteratively reweighted optimization: replace the single global pair-max objective with per-point row maxima $r_i=\max_{j\ne i}\langle x_i,x_j\rangle$ (smoothed as $r_i(\tau)=\tau\log\sum_{j\ne i}\exp(\langle x_i,x_j\rangle/\tau)$) and minimize $(\sum_i w_i\, r_i(\tau)^p)^{1/p}$ with $p$ annealed $8\to64$ and $\tau$ annealed $0.01\to0.0007$, updating weights multiplicatively every stage as $w_i\leftarrow w_i\exp(\beta(r_i-\bar r))$ with $\beta$ chosen so points above the mean row-max are pushed progressively harder while rattlers receive almost no repulsive force until they approach the bottleneck; implement with Riemannian Adam (project gradient and step to tangent spaces, renormalize), track the spread $\max_i r_i-\min_i r_i$ and the number of points within $10^{-6}$ of the global max as diagnostics, then convert the most equioscillated iterate (not merely the lowest-max iterate) with top-$K$ polish and LP, since the target is a configuration where all 93 row maxima coincide at the optimum.

idea: Three C31-orbit symmetric search over 39 parameters with annealed log-sum-exp and analytic gradients, then symmetry-breaking plus full-dimensional repolish.
direction: Symmetry-constrained search using three $C_{31}$ orbits ($3\times31=93$): parametrize the cyclic action on $\mathbb{R}^{13}$ by six 2D rotation planes with multipliers $a=(1,5,7,11,13,17)\bmod 31$ plus one fixed coordinate, so each orbit is determined by six radii (normalized), six phases, and one axial coordinate ($\approx13$ parameters per orbit, 39 total); generate an orbit by rotating a seed vector through $k=0,\dots,30$, optimize the smooth log-sum-exp max-cosine over these 39 parameters with many (50+) random restarts using `scipy.optimize.minimize` L-BFGS-B with analytic or finite-difference gradients and $\tau$ annealed $0.02\to0.002$, which enforces by construction equal contacts and equal row maxima within each orbit; take the best symmetric result, expand it to a full $(93,13)$ array, break symmetry with tangent perturbations of sizes $10^{-4},10^{-3},10^{-2}$, and repolish each with $p$-norm Adam plus LP, returning the best overall—this explores a genuinely different, rattler-free basin that perturbations of the record cannot reach.

idea: N-changing homotopy with smoothed-repulsion reorganization at N=98 and N=85 followed by greedy delete/regrow and LP polish
direction: $N$-changing homotopy—overshoot then prune, and undershoot then grow: (a) augment `best.npy` with 1–7 extra points placed at refined largest voids to get $N=94$–$100$, optimize each $N$-point problem hard with $p$-continuation ($p=16\to256$) so its contact topology reorganizes around the extra points, then greedily delete the point whose removal most reduces the resulting max (test deleting each of the 15 highest-row-max/highest-degree points, repolishing briefly after each candidate deletion) until back at 93, followed by full LP polish; (b) symmetrically, delete the 5–13 loosest rattlers, optimize the smaller code, and regrow to 93 by void insertion as in Direction 1 but only after the smaller code has reached a distinct optimum; accept intermediate configurations up to $2\times10^{-4}$ worse than the incumbent during the $N\ne93$ phases to force topology change, maintain an archive scored by max cosine, and return the best 93-point result within the 180 s limit.

idea: Rattler-first delete-and-reinsert surgery with void sampling, softmax refinement, shifted p-norm Adam and top-K plus LP polish.

idea: Equalize all row-maxima with balanced per-row softmax repulsion while repeatedly reinserting rattlers into optimized voids and perturbing hubs to jump basins, then anneal global log-sum-exp to squeeze the plateau.
Basin-hopping that escapes the 2-pair plateau by jammed-cloud shakes plus void reinsertion of worst points followed by annealed soft-max Adam and hard top-K max descent with hill-climbing polish.
Bottleneck-pair surgery replacing the maximal-pair points by global void search plus annealed refinement and full polish.
direction: Perform bottleneck-pair surgery instead of deleting rattlers: identify the four points participating in the two exact maximal pairs, together with any points tied within $10^{-8}$, remove only those points, and freeze the remaining configuration. Generate at least $5\times10^5$ random unit directions in batches, score each by its maximum cosine against the frozen points, refine the best 200 by tangent Adam on an annealed log-sum-exp void objective, and reinsert the removed points sequentially, each time choosing and refining a direction that minimizes its maximum cosine to both the frozen points and previously reinserted points. Then unfreeze all 93 points for a short annealed Adam polish followed by the tangent-LP polish, repeat with several random seeds, and keep the best exact result; this directly attacks the points causing the bottleneck and searches globally for their replacements in the largest spherical voids.

idea: Bottleneck-pair surgery that removes the maximal-pair points, globally searches 500k voids for replacements with annealed LSE tangent-Adam refinement and sequential reinsertion, then full Adam plus tangent-LP trust-region polish over several seeds.

idea: Shake the single-pair plateau with perturbed softmax annealing plus Top-K cloud balancing and void surgery, then LP polish.
Sample hundreds of C93 single-orbit frequency sets and solve each exactly by LP over simplex weights, then break symmetry with noise and anneal with full Riemannian Adam plus tangent-LP polish.
direction: Search for a vertex-transitive configuration with a single cyclic $C_{93}$ orbit, a structure fundamentally different from both the record basin and the previously tried three $C_{31}$ orbits: parametrize one orbit by six radii, one axial coordinate with $\sum_j r_j^2+c^2=1$, and six distinct frequencies $a_j$ chosen from $1,\ldots,46$, with points generated by $\bigl(r_j\cos(2\pi a_jk/93+\phi_j),r_j\sin(2\pi a_jk/93+\phi_j),c\bigr)$ for $k=0,\ldots,92$. Randomly sample a few hundred frequency sets, rapidly optimize the radii, phases, and axial coordinate for each with annealed log-sum-exp objectives at several temperatures, rank them by exact maximum cosine, then take the best few, break the symmetry by releasing all $93\times13$ coordinates, and finish with Riemannian Adam plus tangent-LP polishing. By construction every point has the same contact multiplicities and there are no rattlers, so any successful example would supply precisely the balanced, rigid contact structure absent from the current best.

idea: Contact-graph cluster surgery with rotation/reflection kicks, short softmax-Adam screening and LP promotion with Gram-fingerprint archive.
direction: Use contact-graph cluster surgery for a genuine topology change while preserving most of the good structure: construct a graph using pairs with slack below $10^{-6}$ or $10^{-5}$, find clusters or communities in that graph, and generate trial configurations by applying a random rotation in a random coordinate 2-plane, with angle $0.03$–$0.20$ radians, to one cluster, or by reflecting one cluster through a random coordinate hyperplane and renormalizing. Screen each trial with a deliberately short annealed softmax Adam polish (for example $\tau=3\times10^{-3}\to3\times10^{-4}$ for about 300 steps), promote only trials reaching below roughly $0.245$ to a full LP polish, and maintain an archive distinguished by sorted-Gram fingerprints so successive trials do not collapse back to the same contact topology. Continue these structured kicks until about 160 seconds, returning the best configuration found and falling back to the input best if none improves it.

idea: Active-set tangent LP with realistic 2e-6 tolerance and Householder bases plus NNLS KKT filtering to exhaust the basin.
direction: Convert the near-plateau into a certified true local optimum with an active-set tangent LP using a realistic tolerance, rather than the misleading $10^{-9}$ threshold: starting from `best.npy`, repeatedly collect the top 800–1500 pairs or all pairs with slack below $2\times10^{-6}$, build a Householder tangent basis for each point, solve the HiGHS LP minimizing $t$ subject to linearized pair cosines $\le t$ and $\|y\|_\infty\le\rho$ with $\rho$ initially $10^{-3}$, retract exactly to the sphere, accept only steps reducing the exact maximum, and halve $\rho$ on failure down to $10^{-9}$. After each accepted step, solve nonnegative least squares for multipliers of the active contact gradients to measure the KKT residual and drop constraints with persistently negative multipliers; run this for at most 150 seconds, always retaining the best exact configuration encountered, so the result either squeezes out the remaining in-basin gain or proves that this basin is locally exhausted.

idea: Escape the single-pair plateau by alternating max-pair deletion with void-regrow surgery and tangent-noise basin hops, each followed by annealed soft-max Adam and top-K hard-max descent.
Screen hundreds of C93 single-orbit frequency sets by exact LP over simplex weights then break symmetry with full-coordinate annealed softmax Adam and LP polish.
